lines.text: David comes to Nob, where trembling Ahimelech asks why he is alone, and David asks for five loaves.
Ahimelech has only consecrated bread and gives it to David after hearing the young men kept from women.
Doeg the Edomite, Saul's chief shepherd, is at Nob that day, detained before the LORD.
Ahimelech offers David the sword of Goliath, whom David killed in the Valley of Sorek.
David flees to Achish king of Ashdod, fears him, pretends insanity, and Achish asks why his servants brought him.
